[[File:Flare_gun_SWTOR.png|thumb|250px|A Flare gun]]
A '''flare gun''' or '''flare pistol'''<ref name="Elrood">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref> was a device used to launch a [[Flare/Legends|flare]] of light into the air to signal for help when in distress or to notify of the user's location. After the [[Battle of Alderaan]], hundreds of [[Republic trooper]]s used Flare guns to alert the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] after the victory over the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Hope">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A Flare gun prop is included in the Collectors Edition of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''<ref name="Collector's Edition">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20111021|text=A Look Inside the Collector's Edition}}</ref> as well as the Digital Upgrade Pack.<ref name="TOR Store">{{TORweb|url=buy|text=Store}}</ref>
